emails.subject: Virtuoso crashing on netlist import, second block affected
emails.body:
Hi team,

We're seeing the same consistent SIGSEGV in Virtuoso 23.1.1 whenever we attempt to import the attached netlist. The crash happens reproducibly and is blocking our tape-out scheduled for Friday.

Stacktrace excerpt:
  #0 0x00007f8a2c3d1234 in VirtuosoCore::NetlistParser::parseNode

We've tried reverting to 22.1 and the import succeeds. This appears to be a regression.

Priya Sharma
Sr. Design Engineer, GlobalFab
